intro: This course covered recognising emergencies, working through DR ABC, calling 999, and giving safe first aid for bleeding, shock, burns, choking and serious illness.
points: This is awareness only and does not qualify you as a first aider — get accredited practical training before acting as one.
Work through DR ABC — check Danger first and never put yourself at risk, as a second casualty helps no one.
If someone is unresponsive and not breathing normally, call 999 and start CPR; if breathing, place them in the recovery position.
Use FAST for stroke — Face, Arms, Speech, Time — and call 999 at once if you see any single sign.
Control severe bleeding with firm pressure on the wound, and cool any burn under running water for at least 20 minutes.
Record every incident accurately as soon as you can, tell your manager, and follow your setting's policies for reporting.
